name: Park Slope PBQ 2025

venue.name: [Logicus Math School](https://www.logicusmath.com)
venue.details: Take the stairs to the second floor and follow the signs

information: Due to the limited space, each competitor may bring at most 1 guest to the competition. This competition only has blind events and Fewest Moves. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [other competitions in New York](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=New+York).
